subject: Coord: NexaBank SOC2 & DPA walkthrough — timezone + evidence handoff
messages:
From: Linda Cheng <linda.cheng@nexabank.com>
To: priya_natarajan@redwood.com
Cc: security@nexabank.com
Date: Thu, 11 Jul 2029 09:12:00 +0100
Subject: SOC2 + DPA review — initial scheduling

Hi Priya,

Thanks for the earlier intro. We’re ready to move forward with a combined SOC2 walkthrough and DPA review so our internal audit team can sign off before procurement. High-level asks:

- 60–90 minute session covering control mapping + evidence transfer approach
- Short overview of pen-test scope and whether third-party pen vendors will need access
- Confirmation of data residency and our DPA acceptance flow (DocuSign preferred)

We’re thinking the week of July 22 (CET) but can be flexible — mornings CET are best for our audit team. I attached our preliminary questionnaire to help you triage evidence. Can you propose 2–3 slots and an evidence upload path?

Thanks,
Linda Cheng
Head of Audit Programs
NexaBank Inc.
Attachment: nexa_prelim_questionnaire.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet)
From: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.com>
To: Linda Cheng <linda.cheng@nexabank.com>
Cc: priyom_das@redwood.com, ben_carter@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 11 Jul 2029 11:03:00 +0100
Subject: Re: SOC2 + DPA review — initial scheduling

Hi Linda — great to hear, thanks for sending the questionnaire.

Proposed slots (all CET):
- Tue Jul 23, 09:00–10:30 CET
- Wed Jul 24, 11:00–12:30 CET
- Thu Jul 25, 14:00–15:00 CET (shorter deep-dive option)

A few notes so we’re aligned:
- I’ve looped in Ben (Sales Engineering) and Priyom (Security Eng) who will drive the live control mapping and the evidence walkthrough.
- We’ll use a shared Drive folder for evidence exchange; please upload to this path: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1A2b3C_nexa-upload. We’ll provide a read-only mirror if you prefer.
- For the DPA: we can pre-send a DocuSign link for signature during/after the meeting; do you want the legal redline reviewed prior to the call?
- Pen test: Priyom will outline the model around pen vendor access. If Nexa plans to use an external vendor, please confirm their name/email and whether they need dedicated test credentials.

Attachments for your prep: redwood_evidence_template.pdf (controls + typical evidence filenames).

If any of those slots work, I’ll lock the calendar invite and include the bridge details + the DocuSign link.

Best,
Priya Natarajan
Senior Solutions Manager, Redwood Inference
From: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
To: priya_natarajan@redwood.com, ben_carter@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 11 Jul 2029 14:25:00 +0100
Subject: Re: SOC2 + DPA review — internal availability

Priya / Ben — I’m good for Jul 23 morning or Jul 24 mid-morning. For the pen-test piece:

- I’ll present our pen-test process (what access is required, timing, and expected artifacts).
- If Nexa wants their vendor to run tests, we typically provide a scoped IP allowlist and short-lived credentials; we do not give persistent access to production systems.

Ben — can you confirm whether you want to open with the product demo (10–15m) or jump straight to controls? My preference is short demo then controls.

Thanks,
Priyom
Security Engineering

Date: Fri, 12 Jul 2029 16:05:00 +0100
Subject: Re: SOC2 + DPA review — initial scheduling

Thanks — Jul 23 09:00–10:30 CET works for us. We’ll plan for 75 minutes: 10–15m quick product overview, 45m control mapping/evidence review, 15–20m on pen-test and DPA next steps.

Action items before the call:
- I’ll upload the completed questionnaire to your Drive link by Monday (Nexa internal security will redact PII where necessary).
- We’ll share our preferred pen vendor (SecureProbe Ltd, contact: paul.turner@secureprobe.com) and confirm they’ll need scoped access.
- Yes, please send the DocuSign DPA ahead of time; legal prefers a short window to review prior to signature.

Calendar request: please include a dial-in (Zoom) and a short agenda in the invite.

Appreciate it — looking forward to the call.

Best,
Linda Cheng
Head of Audit Programs, NexaBank Inc.
